description: This Sources Sought is not a request for quotation or offer to form a contract.  Charleston AFB is seeking to identify vendors capable of providing a ~15-minute De Havilland DH-115 flight demonstration on both Saturday, May 2, and Sunday, May 3, 2026, as part of the JB Charleston Airshow. The performer must arrive at the base by Thursday, April 30, to allow for crew rest prior to the mandatory safety briefing and practice day on Friday, May 1.  JB CHS requests vendors capable of providing DH-115 flying demonstrations contact the government POC's identified in this notice.
